resources.string: Records which Douyin and TikTok posts appear on screen for an approved research study. It reads only these two apps and never records comment text, messages, or any other app.
Enter the email address enrolled in the study
Not a Douyin or TikTok link
Paste a Douyin or TikTok link
Could not save the copied link
Copy a link in Douyin or TikTok and open this app — it is saved automatically. You can also paste one here.
Shows a small button over Douyin and TikTok. Copy a link there, tap the button, and it is recorded without leaving the app.
Allow "display over other apps", then tap again

Repeats the copy-link step for you. Open Douyin or TikTok, search, filter to the last day, then come back and start a run. It stops on its own after the time or video limit, and the moment you leave the app.
Dry run — find the buttons, press nothing
Running. Switch to the app now.
Dry run. Switch to the app and open one share sheet.
Do the first video by hand first, so the run starts from a video and not a menu.
